field_descriptions.date_created: The date on which the CreativeWork was created or the item was added to a DataFeed.
field_descriptions.date_deleted: The datetime the item was removed from the DataFeed.
field_descriptions.date_modified: The date on which the CreativeWork was most recently modified or when the item's entry was modified within a DataFeed.
field_descriptions.identifier: The identifier property represents any kind of identifier for any kind of [[Thing]], such as ISBNs, GTIN codes, UUIDs etc. Schema.org provides dedicated properties for representing many of these, either as textual strings or as URL (URI) links. See [background notes](/docs/datamodel.html#identifierBg) for more details.
field_descriptions.item: An entity represented by an entry in a list or data feed (e.g. an 'artist' in a list of 'artists').
